Buy a Passport via Telegram

Searching for a passport on Telegram returns a hundred near-identical adverts and no way to rank them. The only reliable filter is knowing what the national issuing authority puts on the document and what a print cannot reproduce.

Issuing authority
Varies by country, always a government office. Named on every country page.
Observed price band
180 to 900 USD
Typical delivery
3 to 28 days, tracked
What it proves
A passport is the travel document a state issues to its own nationals. It is the only document on this site that proves nationality rather than residence or entitlement.

buy passport via telegram – the short version

The price question and the quality question are the same question for a passport. Cheap means the security layer was skipped, and the security layer is the only part that is hard to fake.

The next section covers how the transaction itself runs, because the ordering of photos, checks and payment is where most deals actually fail, not the document inspection.

Before paying for a passport, ask for a UV shot of the data page and a close crop of the number field. Both are cheap for the seller and both expose a print immediately.

buy passport on telegram: how it works in practice

Treat the chat as a written record. Ask in full sentences, keep the answers, screenshot the price. If the deal sours you will want the thread rather than a summary of it.

If the deal collapses after the deposit, write a dated summary in the chat, name the amount and stop. Sellers respond to a record far more than to complaint.

The transaction runs in a private chat, usually after a public channel advert. That is fine. What matters is that the sequence is fixed before money moves: photos first, then a number check, then payment, then tracked delivery.

What you should actually receive

A complete passport is a set of things, not a single image. Insist on all five before any money moves.

  • A data page carrying your photo, name, date of birth, place of birth, issue date and expiry date.
  • A machine-readable zone at the foot of the data page with check digits that compute correctly.
  • A cover carrying the state name, the state emblem and document type letter P.
  • A passport number that matches the visual page and the machine-readable zone character for character.
  • The security features the issuing state actually uses, from polycarbonate data page to holographic overlay to UV ink.

Who actually issues a passport

The issuing authority for a passport is the national issuing authority. Nobody on Telegram issues anything. Sellers are downstream of that office and the only question worth asking is how many steps downstream they are.

Local name matters more than it sounds. Using the local name of the document rather than a translated term shows the seller you are not reading from a generic script, and the quality of the answers changes immediately.

Replica or registered original

Never accept the word original as a category. It is an adjective. The specification is the register, and a register either answers or it does not.

Whichever tier you buy, ask for it in writing. A one-line message saying the number does or does not resolve is worth more than any amount of reassurance in prose.

What a fair price looks like

Fair pricing on a passport is not about the cheapest number in the chat. It is about paying the bottom of the band for a print and the top only when somebody shows a register hit.

If a quote is far below, ask what was left out. The answer is almost always the security layer or the stock, and either one turns the document into a print.

The buying process, step by step

Run this sequence once, properly, rather than half of it three times with three sellers.

  1. Ask which office issued it and confirm the answer is the national issuing authority.
  2. Request an uncropped photo of the full card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame.
  3. Request a UV shot of the data page and a close crop of the number field.
  4. Test the number against the format the national issuing authority uses. A number that breaks the format ends the deal.
  5. Agree a price inside the 420 USD band and pay in two parts, deposit then balance against tracking.
  6. On arrival check the document against the photos before you accept delivery and photograph the unopened envelope.

Checks that catch bad stock

Do these in daylight, with the card in your hand, and never accept a photo as proof of any of them.

  • Scan the machine-readable zone with any free reader app. If the check digits fail, the book is a print.
  • Compare the number across the data page, the machine-readable zone and every visa or stamp inside the book.
  • Shine a UV torch along the data page. Every state in this list prints UV ink there.
  • Check the number format against the published rule for the national issuing authority. Constructed numbers cannot be invented by hand.
  • Look for the UV print with a 365 nanometre torch. Real ink is sharp and placed deliberately. A print shows a dull bloom or nothing.
  • Loupe the microprint and the ghost image. Both collapse into a dotted line or a grey patch on a photocopy.
  • Compare the data across every field for internal consistency. A postcode that contradicts the state or the office area is a tell.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a fused seal rather than a cut line under a laid sheet.

Red flags that should end the conversation

None of these are fatal alone. All of them are fatal when the seller has no explanation.

  • The seller sends a data page photo with no cover, no machine-readable zone and no laminate edge in frame.
  • The expiry date sits exactly ten years after issue on a country that issues five-year books to adults.
  • The seller cannot name the issuing office, only the country.
  • The number breaks the published format, or is round and repeating.

Frequently asked questions

What should a passport cost on Telegram?

Between 180 and 900 US dollars depending on whether you are buying a print, correct stock, or a number that resolves at the issuing office.

Is a Telegram passport genuine?

Usually not. Most adverts sell a replica or a registered original, and the two are priced very differently. Ask which one it is in writing.

How long does delivery take?

Adverts quote anything from same day to four weeks. A tracked number that moves inside 48 hours is the realistic standard.

Can a passport number be checked?

Only against the issuing office register or an airline check-in system. A seller who offers no route to a register check is selling a print.

What is the most common fake?

A colour photocopy of a real data page laminated into a blank cover with a plausible number typed in.

Before you pay

Take the checks above into the chat. If a seller passes all of them, the passport is worth the top of the band.
